benchmark.decoding: greedy argmax, temperature not sampled, cache-free full-prefix recomputation
benchmark.gsm_score: numeric equality: final ####, then boxed, then last numeric occurrence; strict diagnostic
benchmark.wiki_score: native token NLL/perplexity and bits per UTF-8 byte on nonoverlapping windows; BOS/EOS; not official word PPL

calibration.objective: human GSM8K train reference tokens + WikiText train next tokens; no teacher targets
calibration.selection: lowest equally weighted math/language development token NLL; same recipient tokenizer

criteria.complementarity: source capability, retention, and functional criteria all pass
criteria.functional: paired bootstrap 95% lower bounds > 0: math full minus donor bypass; language prefix/suffix bypass minus full
criteria.improvement: both primary scores better than both parents with positive paired confidence bounds
criteria.limitations: single-seed exploratory confidence; contiguous WikiText windows correlated; pretraining contamination unknown

mamba_license_origin.limitation: HF-converted repository has no direct license tag/document. Original official checkpoint supplies lineage evidence; do not redistribute frozen weights.

reverse_policy: structural-only after first child validates; no scaling without measured primary retention/contribution
scope: CPU exploratory pilot; underpowered for registered inheritance criteria
